name: Winter Bliss ~Meeting You~
source: "When I was little, my father would always tell me not to go to the mountain. It's a dangerous place, he said. It's a mountain that would snow once every year. Legend says, that on top of the mountain lies a terrifying creature that would turn anyone who gets near it to ice. I was a kid back then... and I didn't really care that much about it. I would listen to my parents warning, but I would ignore it right away. There was an old song that the town's people used to sing. They say it's a story about a forgotten king."
translation: “小时候，父亲总是告诉我不要去山上。他说，这是一个危险的地方。这是一座每年都会下雪的山。传说，山顶上有一种可怕的生物，它会把任何靠近它的人变成冰。那时我还是个孩子……我并不太在意它。我会听父母的警告，但我会立即忽略它。镇上的人曾经有一首老歌他们说这是一个关于一个被遗忘的国王的故事。”
